tickets.summary: K-3401 non-drive end bearing vibration increased from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s in six weeks with growing 1x component and no plateau, indicating active degradation on the single-train export compressor.
tickets.recommended_action: Rotating equipment specialist inspect bearing/vibration cause same day; correct defects and confirm vibration trend stabilises Diagnose vibration source and progression

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The compressor retains function, but vibration has more than doubled with a continuing upward trend and growing spectral features, indicating active degradation and elevated risk of near-term functional interruption.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the single-train export compressor would rapidly reduce production with no installed redundancy or workaround, creating a severe operational consequence.

tickets.summary: Corrosion inhibitor pump P-3305 has tripped three times this month on low discharge pressure and injection has been intermittent for about ten days, leaving downstream carbon steel corrosion protection degraded.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect diaphragm and low-pressure cause; repair as found and restore continuous inhibitor injection. Check impairment/deviation log

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of corrosion inhibitor injection can drive delayed degradation of downstream hydrocarbon pipework with no redundant pump available. Consequences are material but delayed rather than immediate major-accident exposure.
